summary: Drawing from his own grueling **history of overcoming early business struggles**, successful investor Alex Hormozi has launched a high-stakes competition to **mentor struggling entrepreneurs**. In this program, **eight diverse founders pitch their companies** during intense strategy sessions in the hopes of winning a cash prize and a full year of elite guidance. Ultimately, Hormozi puts their business models under a microscope to provide **actionable ninety-day growth roadmaps**, determining which candidates possess the potential to successfully **scale rather than fail**.
